QuestInfo.name: Asking After Chief Stan
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to check on #b#p202##k. Let's go see how #p202# is doing.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p202#, the leader of our town. I'm glad to see he is doing well!

0.0: "I wonder how #p202# is doing lately. They often overexert themselves for the sake of the town. It would be wonderful if you could check on him for me.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Ah, #h0#. What brings you by today? Hm? #p229# asked you to check on how I was doing? Haha, that fellow is worrying over nothing.
1.1: I suppose I am getting older, and my body isn't quite what it used to be, but that only keeps my mind sharper. So go on and tell them there is absolutely no need to worry about me. Haha!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, I must say.
